snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.7 Trailer | Where Stars Yearn
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.7 Trailer | Where Stars Yearn
 
A message from the summer night arrives, and every note begins to resonate with joy.
Bubbles and fireworks drift together into this dazzling encounter, while melodies ripple through the air and flowing light traces every joyful silhouette.
Between every heartbeat and every step, a spark of starlight lingers, turning a fleeting moment along the journey into eternity.
 
Infinity Nikki Version 2.7 [Where Stars Yearn] launches on June 23 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for the exclusive quest [Every Moment, Countless Journeys]! Dive into exciting gameplay updates like [Pick Your Dream Stage]. Stylists, don't miss out—jump in and discover all the fun!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.7 Where Stars Yearn launches globally on June 23 (UTC-7)!
